data.title: Social Media Manager – Gastronomie & Hospitality (H/F)
data.description:
REJOIGNEZ UNE AGENCE EN PLEINE CROISSANCE !

Vous aimez la gastronomie, les belles maisons, les restaurants, les chefs et l'hôtellerie haut de gamme ?

Vous avez le sens de l'image, une vraie sensibilité esthétique et aimez raconter des histoires à travers les réseaux sociaux ?

Vous savez qu'un compte Instagram ne se résume pas à publier du contenu : il s'agit de construire un univers, de retranscrire l'identité d'une maison et de créer une véritable expérience de marque.

Alors, vous êtes peut-être notre prochain·e Social Media Manager !

Chez Culinary Agency, nous sommes spécialisés dans la communication digitale des acteurs de la gastronomie et de l'Hospitality. Nous accompagnons des restaurants, chefs, hôtels et marques dans le développement de leur image et de leur présence sur les réseaux sociaux.

Dans le cadre de notre croissance et du développement de notre portefeuille clients, nous recrutons un·e Social Media Manager en CDI pour renforcer notre équipe.

VOS MISSIONS

En lien direct avec les clients, notre directrice stratégique et opérationnelle et nos équipes de création de contenu, vous prenez en main la gestion quotidienne des réseaux sociaux de votre portefeuille.

Vous serez responsable d'environ 7 à 8 comptes clients, avec pour objectif de développer leur visibilité, leur engagement et la cohérence de leur image de marque.

Vos missions s'articuleront autour de trois grands axes :

1. STRATÉGIE ÉDITORIALE & IDENTITÉ DE MARQUE

  • Participer à la définition des identités visuelles des nouveaux clients sur les réseaux sociaux.

  • Construire des calendriers éditoriaux mensuels adaptés à chaque établissement ou marque.

  • Comprendre et retranscrire les codes, le positionnement et l'univers de chaque client.

  • Imaginer des prises de parole et des storytelling cohérents avec l'identité de chaque maison.

2. CRÉATION DE CONTENU & GESTION INSTAGRAM

  • Créer des stories et carrousels visuellement soignés.

  • Monter des stories vidéo et adapter les contenus aux différents formats Instagram.

  • Rédiger des captions engageantes, avec une attention particulière portée au ton et à l'identité de chaque client.

  • Programmer et diffuser les publications aux moments et dans les conditions les plus pertinents.

  • Veiller à la bonne exploitation des contenus produits par nos équipes de création (photos, vidéos et Reels).

3. ANIMATION & PERFORMANCE

  • Assurer la modération des comptes : réponses aux commentaires et aux messages privés.

  • Veiller à la cohérence et à la qualité des publications.

  • Suivre les tendances Social Media, Instagram, Food et Hospitality.

  • Identifier les nouveaux formats et les opportunités permettant d'améliorer la visibilité et les performances des comptes.

VOTRE RYTHME DE PRODUCTION

Vous évoluerez sur un portefeuille de 7 à 8 clients, avec un rythme pouvant aller jusqu'à :

4 stories par semaine et par client.

1 carrousel par semaine et par client.

4 Reels diffusés par semaine et par client.

Vous travaillerez en coordination avec nos équipes de création de contenu, qui vous accompagneront dans la production des contenus photo et vidéo.

Vous serez accompagné·e à votre arrivée par notre directrice des opérations et une Social Media Manager senior. L'objectif : vous permettre de prendre progressivement vos marques et de gérer votre portefeuille en autonomie.

LE PROFIL QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

Nous recherchons une personne ayant déjà une première expérience professionnelle en Social Media Management.

Une expérience dans la restauration, la gastronomie, l'hôtellerie ou l'Hospitality sera particulièrement appréciée.

Deux critères sont indispensables pour ce poste :

1. Vous avez déjà géré plusieurs comptes Social Media simultanément.

Vous avez une expérience concrète de la gestion de plusieurs comptes clients en parallèle. Vous savez jongler entre différents univers, respecter des calendriers éditoriaux et adapter votre communication à chaque marque.

Une première expérience en agence ou dans un environnement multi-clients est particulièrement pertinente.

2. Vous avez un véritable intérêt pour la gastronomie et les univers haut de gamme.

Restaurants, chefs, belles maisons, hôtels, expériences gastronomiques… Ces univers vous attirent sincèrement.

Vous n'avez pas nécessairement besoin d'y avoir travaillé, mais vous devez avoir envie de les découvrir, d'en comprendre les codes et de savoir les mettre en valeur.

Au-delà de ces deux indispensables, vous êtes une personne qui :

  • Possède un véritable œil esthétique et une forte sensibilité à l'image.

  • Maîtrise les codes d'Instagram et des formats courts.

  • Aime créer des contenus visuels et monter des vidéos.

  • Possède de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et une orthographe irréprochable.

  • Est curieuse, créative et attentive aux tendances Social Media.

  • Fait preuve de rigueur, d'organisation et d'une grande attention aux détails.

  • Sait gérer plusieurs projets et priorités en simultané.

  • Est autonome, réactive et apprécie le travail en équipe.

  • A envie d'apprendre, de progresser et de s'investir dans une agence ambitieuse.

CE QUE NOUS VOUS PROPOSONS

Une rémunération adaptée à votre expérience :

Profil junior : 27 000 à 28 000 € brut annuel fixe complété par une rémunération variable pouvant atteindre 1 000 € brut annuel.

Profil expérimenté : rémunération pouvant atteindre 35 000 € brut annuel fixe selon l'expérience et le niveau d'autonomie.

VOS AVANTAGES

Télétravail : prime mensuelle de 50 € brut.

Transports : prise en charge de 50 % de l'abonnement aux transports en commun, y compris en télétravail.

Noël : bons cadeaux offerts.

Croissance de l'agence : mise en place en cours d'une prime complémentaire liée au développement de Culinary Agency.

Matériel professionnel : iPhone et ordinateur fournis.

ORGANISATION DU TRAVAIL

Localisation : Lyon

Nous fonctionnons actuellement sans bureaux fixes. Nous privilégions le télétravail et les sessions de travail en cafés avec le reste de l'équipe, organisées régulièrement. Des bureaux sont envisagés dans les prochains mois.

Horaires habituels : 9h30 – 18h30, avec une certaine flexibilité selon les besoins des clients.

Organisation libre entre télétravail et sessions de travail avec l'équipe.

Déplacements :

Environ un déplacement par trimestre en Île-de-France.

Quelques déplacements ponctuels en région selon les besoins des clients.

NOTRE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

Nous souhaitons prendre le temps de rencontrer les candidats et d'évaluer concrètement leur sensibilité créative, leur compréhension des réseaux sociaux et leur capacité à gérer plusieurs comptes clients.

Notre processus se déroule en quatre étapes :

1. Entretien de préqualification en visioconférence

Un premier échange pour faire connaissance, comprendre votre parcours et vous présenter Culinary Agency.

2. Étude de cas / mise en situation

Si le premier échange est concluant, nous vous proposons un exercice pratique pour mieux comprendre votre approche créative et votre manière de travailler.

3. Prise de références professionnelles

Nous souhaitons échanger avec des personnes ayant déjà travaillé avec vous.

4. Entretien final avec le CEO fondateur

Un dernier échange pour approfondir votre candidature et vous permettre de découvrir la vision et les ambitions de l'agence.

POURQUOI REJOINDRE CULINARY AGENCY ?

Rejoindre Culinary Agency, c'est intégrer une agence en pleine croissance, spécialisée dans des univers passionnants, où l'image, la créativité et le sens du détail occupent une place centrale.

Vous travaillerez sur des projets variés, auprès de restaurants, chefs, hôtels et marques, avec la possibilité de développer votre expertise en Social Media Management dans l'univers de la gastronomie et de l'Hospitality.

Vous aimez les beaux contenus, les belles histoires et les univers qui ont une véritable identité ?

Vous avez envie de rejoindre une équipe ambitieuse et de participer activement au développement d'une agence en pleine expansion ?

Nous serions ravis de découvrir votre profil !

data.title: AFC Sanctions & Investigations Officer
data.description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join our Finance Crime team as an Anti-Financial Crime Officer, specialized in sanctions, PEP analysis and adverse media investigations. You'll screen and resolve complex alerts, make accept/refuse calls on transaction screening, and help sharpen our second-line sanctions controls, under the guidance of Martina, our Lead AFC Sanctions & Investigations.

 

➡️ What you'll do

  • Screen and investigate alerts: you review sanctions, PEP and adverse media matches from our screening tool (ComplyAdvantage), assess real exposure, and document your conclusions with a full audit trail.

  • Decide on transaction screening alerts: you accept or refuse alerts within defined criteria, and escalate the ambiguous or high-risk ones to senior leads.

  • Keep files audit-ready: you maintain detailed PEP and sanctions case documentation, and handle asset-freezing and homonymy declarations to the DGT.

  • Be the reference for your markets: you're the go-to sanctions & investigations contact for your assigned markets, keeping procedures, evidence packs and decision rationales ready for internal and external review.

  • Work across teams and improve how we work: you partner with AML, Fraud, SEPA and Open Banking colleagues to resolve complex cases, and you spot gaps worth fixing in our processes and screening-tool calibration.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Sanctions & PEP expertise: you have at least 1-2 years (including apprenticeship) in compliance, sanctions regimes, PEP frameworks and adverse media standards, and you keep that knowledge current as regulations evolve.

  • Hands-on screening experience: you're comfortable screening and investigating alerts in tools like ComplyAdvantage, backed by a foundational understanding of AML/CFT.

  • Documentation discipline: you build clear, complete, audit-ready case files and control narratives that hold up under real scrutiny.

  • A cross-functional instinct: you work well with AML, Fraud, SEPA and Open Banking teams, and you're quick to spot and propose fixes for process or calibration gaps.

  • Market and language coverage: you're comfortable being the point of contact for one or more European markets, with the language coverage that requires.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Real ownership: you make daily accept/refuse decisions on sanctions and PEP cases that genuinely matter, not just paperwork.

  • A seat across Risk & Compliance: you work closely with AML, Fraud, SEPA and Open Banking teams across Qonto's European markets.

  • A voice in how we improve: beyond casework, you contribute to process and screening-tool calibration projects.

➡️ Your future manager

You’ll report to Martina, Lead AFC Sanctions & Investigations. data.title: GTM & Value Creation Lead
data.description:
About Hexa

Hexa builds and scales software companies alongside entrepreneurs. Since its launch as eFounders, Hexa has helped create companies including Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign.

Hexa Scale is a small-cap software investment firm deploying a €100 million fund. We take majority stakes in established B2B software companies and work directly with their founders to unlock their next stage of growth. We bring capital, but first and formemost operators who get involved in the daily work to build the fundamentals required to ignite a real Sscaling story: go-to-market, product, hiring and the systems needed.

Hexa Scale

Many software companies have a strong product and loyal customers but have yet to build a repeatable growth engine. Their next phase calls for more than optimising today’s funnel: they need to rethink how they find, win, serve and grow customers as AI changes both customer workflows and commercial execution. They need people who can test what works with their teams and turn the learning into a way of operating.

That is what we do at Hexa Scale. We invest in software companies with roughly €2–10 million in ARR and work alongside their founders after the investment. Our approach is hands-on, with go-to-market at the centre of the acceleration plan?

Mission

We’re looking for a Value Creation Manager with a strong GTM background to join the Hexa Scale team. You will assess growth opportunities and feasibility before an investment decision, then work across our portfolio with founders and their teams to remove growth bottlenecks. Your judgement will help the investment team test whether a company has strong, executable growth potential; your operating work will help turn that potential into results.

This is a GTM-major role: your core craft is building a next-generation go-to-market engine, combining customer insight, commercial execution, data and AI-enabled workflows. You have built or improved commercial motions inside a fast-growing startup, and you are as comfortable with positioning and customer interviews as with sales execution, pricing & process optimization. The remit can become broader as the needs and maturity of each portfolio company change, particularly where product is the best route to more customer value and growth.

You will not be an external advisor producing slides for a management team. You will work with that team, from within the company, establish a useful operating cadence and leave behind a system they can run without you.

What you’ll do

As a preliminary note and as you’ll understand based on the 4 pillars below, the role is in close synch with the investment team. You’ll be a sparing partner, brining both your expert judgement as well as your field working competences to the table. While the role will enable lots of autonomy, you’ll be working in close synch with one or more investment partners, who’re experienced entrepreneurs you’ll learn from and who’ll have the final call on major decisions.

Participate in investment selection

  • Assess growth potential: Work with the deal team before an investment decision to test whether the growth opportunity is substantial, accessible and actionable, rather than relying on an optimistic management plan.

  • Support commercial diligence: support the investment team in interviews of customers and prospects; examine segmentation, win/loss, funnel conversion, sales cycles, retention and expansion, pricing, channels and the capacity of the current team to execute.

  • Underwrite the growth levers: Prioritize potential improvements in GTM, pricing, upmarket sales or distribution. Quantify the starting point, expected impact, costs, timing, dependencies and downside. Separate demonstrated opportunities from assumptions that still need testing.

  • Turn diligence into a plan: Present an evidence-based growth-engineering assessment to the investment team, including what could disprove the thesis and an initial post-close step-by-step execution roadmap. Final investment decisions remain with the partners.

Build a next-generation go-to-market engine

  • Find the constraint: Work with founders and commercial teams to understand where growth stalls, from targeting and lead generation to conversion, onboarding and expansion.

  • Get close to customers: Run interviews, listen to sales calls, examine lost deals and translate what you learn into sharper segmentation, messaging and offers.

  • Run experiments: Lead and co-run tests with teams across outbound, partnerships, demand generation, pricing, AI-assisted prospecting and sales processes. Set a baseline, define what success looks like, measure conversion and unit economics, and stop what doesn’t work, while bringing teams along so the new ways of working stick.

  • Build AI-enabled GTM workflows: Design and test practical workflows for research, targeting, qualification, sales preparation, customer success or expansion using AI tools and agents where appropriate. Measure quality, adoption, cost and human oversight, not just activity or demos.

  • Make the funnel usable: Improve CRM discipline, pipeline visibility, forecasting and the handoffs between marketing, sales and customer success. Automate repeatable work where it improves the customer experience and commercial outcomes.

Execute alongside portfolio teams

  • Connect product and growth: As portfolio needs and maturity vary, partner with product teams to increase customer value and create new growth paths. Explore features such as embedded finance or agentic execution where relevant; validate customer demand, adoption, willingness to pay, implementation costs and margins before treating them as growth levers.

  • Work with founders: Help turn priorities into a weekly cadence, clear owners and decisions grounded in customer and commercial evidence.

  • Build internal capability: Coach or assist in recruiting when needed the people who will own the work long term. Document the useful parts of a playbook without imposing the same answer on every company.

  • Own critical projects: Take responsibility for a defined growth or operating problem, from diagnosis through implementation, rather than handing over a recommendation.

Can include temporary embedding in the company on a full-time basis

Strengthen the Hexa Scale operating model

  • Make our work repeatable: Capture what works across portfolio companies and improve the tools and methods we use to diagnose and accelerate growth.

  • Take on adjacent problems: GTM remains your major, but the most valuable work may extend into product, customer operations, hiring or cross-functional execution depending on the company and its stage of maturity. Know when to take ownership and when to bring in a specialist.

  • Use technology pragmatically: Build and deploy AI-enabled workflows with portfolio teams when they improve GTM outcomes or customer value. Assess reliability, cost and operational fit; do not confuse a demo with an adopted process.

What we’re looking for

Experience

  • Five years or more: Substantial time in a fast-growing startup or scale-up in a hands-on GTM role.

  • Commercial execution: You have personally built, operated or significantly improved a B2B growth engine, ideally in a fast-growing startup. You can explain how you changed the GTM motion, what the numbers showed and what you would do differently.

  • B2B software: You understand sales cycles, conversion, retention, expansion, pricing and the trade-offs involved in scaling a team. Experience in high growth vertical SaaS is a plus.

  • Range: You can work across sales, marketing, customer success and operations without needing a large team or a perfectly defined brief.

  • Working with leaders: Experience alongside founders or senior commercial leaders is a strong plus. French and English fluency are required for this role.

Mindset

  • Autonomous: You can turn an ambiguous problem into a plan, make progress and know when a decision needs to be escalated.

  • Hands-on: You are willing to inspect the CRM, join customer calls, rewrite a sequence and run an experiment yourself.

  • AI-fluent: You already build with AI tools and use them in your daily work, not just in occasional demos. You can show workflows or products you have built, explain what worked and failed, and help teams adopt AI where it changes how they go to market.

  • Commercially sharp: You care about revenue outcomes, not activity for its own sake.

  • Versatile without being superficial: GTM is your major, but you can work on product and wider operating problems when they are the real constraint. You connect new customer value to adoption, pricing, retention and growth.

  • Low ego, high standards: You can challenge a founder’s assumption, listen when you are wrong and earn the trust of the team doing the work.

What we offer

  • Ownership: A role at the centre of Hexa Scale’s work with founders, with responsibility for real operating projects across B2B software companies.

  • Team: Direct collaboration with Hexa Scale partners and access to Hexa’s product, talent, brand and operational expertise.

  • Compensation: A competitive package, including carried interest

  • Benefits: Hexa employee benefits may include a Swile meal card, RTT, a green mobility budget and health insurance.

Recruitment process

Proposed process, to confirm with the Talent team:

  1. Introductory call with Hexa’s Talent team.

  2. Interview with the Hexa Scale team on your GTM experience and operating approach.

  3. Practical case on a real pre-investment growth diligence and portfolio execution problem, followed by a working session.

  4. Conversations with the people you would work with most closely.

  5. Reference checks and offer.

data.description:
Le Groupe QUALTECH - 5 sociétés, 7 sites et 350 salariés - est un regroupement de Laboratoires spécialisés dans les analyses de laboratoire (microbiologie, biologie moléculaire, chimie, extraction d’ADN, etc), le conseil, la recherche et la formation. Notre but est de garantir une expertise qualitative à nos clients en termes de contrôle, de qualité et de fiabilité dans le secteur de l’agro-alimentaire.

Nos valeurs : intégrité, innovation, expertise, engagement, orientation client. En rejoignant son laboratoire AGROBIO spécialisé en microbiologie, vous participez à son expertise dans le monde de la recherche et de l’analyse agro-alimentaire.

Vos missions

Dans le cadre d’un remplacement au sein de notre laboratoire AGROBIO, nous vous attendons pour prélever des échantillons (alimentaires, d’eau et de surface) et réaliser des audits d’hygiène chez nos clients situés dans un rayon de 120 km autour de Quimper.

Vous allez avoir l’opportunité de rencontrer les différents acteurs locaux et de découvrir leur activité, qu’ils soient spécialisés dans la restauration collective (crèches, lycées, maisons de retraite, restaurants d’entreprise, armé, abattoirs, etc.) ou plus traditionnelle.

Vous êtes le 1er maillon de cette longue chaîne menant à une analyse de haute fiabilité grâce à la collaboration de chacun. Derrière vous, une équipe logistique présente à tout moment pour vous aider, des techniciens de laboratoire impatients de traiter vos échantillons et des clients à rassurer sur leurs bonnes pratiques vis-à-vis du grand public. Des outils de travail vous sont attribués : un véhicule de service, une carte carburant et de télépéage, un téléphone, une tablette, et des paniers repas pour chaque journée de travail de plus de 6 heures. Enfin, une formation sera assurée en interne à votre prise de poste.

La connaissance de la méthode HACCP sera considérée comme un atout dans votre candidature.

Le métier en images : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vioxi-NwhKw

Type de contrat : CDD, temps plein (35h/sem)

data.title: Chargé·e de Communication (événementiel, RP, communication interne)
data.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Le Média Positif (LMP) est un média français de bonnes nouvelles, fondé en 2021 par Hugues de Rosny.

Sa mission : montrer l'actualité sous un nouveau jour et mettre en lumière celles et ceux qui agissent et entreprennent dans leur territoire.

LMP fait partie du groupe Armoria Médias, qui opère 9 marques éditoriales dans 4 pays(Le Média Vin, Le Média Food, Le Média Expérience, The Bright Side, entre autres). Notre ligne tient en une idée : 0 % de fatalisme, 100 % de solutions inspirantes

LE POSTE

Rattaché·e à la responsable communication, tu deviens son bras droit au sein du pôle communication. Tu prends en main trois chantiers : l'événementiel, les relations presse et la communication interne.

Au-delà de ces missions, tu es son relais au quotidien : tu la secondes dans le pilotage des projets comm, tu assures la continuité en son absence.

MISSIONS PRINCIPALES

  1. Événementiel
  • Concevoir et organiser les événements du média : soirées, anniversaires, rencontres avec la communauté, présence sur des salons et festivals partenaires.
  • Gérer la logistique de bout en bout : lieux, prestataires, budget, planning, invitations et listes d'invités.
  • Coordonner les équipes internes le jour J et assurer la couverture de l'événement avec le pôle Édito.
  1. Relations presse
  • Construire et entretenir le fichier presse et les relations avec les journalistes.
  • Rédiger communiqués et dossiers de presse (lancements, partenariats, chiffres clés,livres, événements).
  • Identifier les opportunités de prise de parole pour le média et ses porte-parole, et assurer le suivi des retombées.
  1. Communication interne
  • Faire circuler l'information entre les pôles (Édito, Brand, Business, Communication) et les marques du groupe.
  • Animer les rendez-vous internes : newsletter interne, temps forts d'équipe, onboarding des nouveaux arrivants.
  • Valoriser les réussites de l'équipe et entretenir la culture d'entreprise.
  1. Bras droit de la responsable communication
  • Participer à la stratégie de communication et à sa mise en œuvre.
  • Suivre les plannings, les budgets et les prestataires du pôle.
  • Prendre le relais sur les projets en cours et représenter le pôle en réunion si besoin.


PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Formation & expérience

  • Formation en communication ou relations presse (Bac+3 à Bac+5).
  • Une première expérience en événementiel ou en communication dans un média.
  • Une belle plume : communiqués, mails, contenus internes, tu sais adapter ton ton à chaque public.
  • Un sens aigu de l'organisation et de la gestion des priorités, avec plusieurs projets menés en parallèle.
  • Du relationnel et de l'aisance à l'oral, avec la presse comme avec les partenaires et l'équipe.
  • De l'autonomie et l'envie de prendre des responsabilités aux côtés de la responsable communication.

Lieu : Paris

data.description:
About You


You're a jack-of-all-trades with a passion for cool technology and interacting with people and making them happy. You're a self-starter who's good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. You've worked directly with customers for a long time and are comfortable being the face of the company to them. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they're happy they partnered with you. Further, you're a curious person, and you'd love the opportunity to work with a technology team that includes data scientists, algorithm experts, back-end and front-end engineers to expand your knowledge.

About Us

Constructor.io powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical.

We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

As a Customer Success Manager, you'll be joining a rapidly growing team that helps our customers increase their revenue by improving the search and product discovery experiences of their websites and mobile apps through integrating with our services.

Your specific responsibilities will include:

  • Advocate effectively for customer needs while exercising strong judgment about when engineering involvement is required, how requests should be prioritized, and when an alternative solution can deliver the desired outcome.

  • Use customer insights, performance data, and ecommerce best practices to provide proactive, strategic recommendations, not simply respond to requests.

  • Maintain clear success plans, stakeholder maps, account documentation, training materials, and agreed actions so that both the customer and Constructor teams remain aligned.

  • Partner closely with Account Management to support retention and growth by demonstrating value, strengthening executive relationships, and identifying opportunities to expand the partnership.

  • Continuously improve how we onboard, integrate, and support customers, sharing repeatable best practices that make our processes more scalable and the customer experience more effective.

Requirements

  • Based in EMEA, ideally in France. Fluency in a French language is a requirement.

  • At least three years of experience managing relationships with enterprise customers in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer-facing role.

  • Experience working with complex enterprise organizations and building trusted relationships with stakeholders ranging from technical teams and product leaders to Ecommerce Directors, VPs, and C-level executives.

  • Strong executive presence and the confidence to lead strategic customer conversations, including QBRs and EBRs.

De la qualification d’un nouveau fournisseur au suivi de sa performance dans la durée, vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie de la relation fournisseur et contribuez activement à l’amélioration continue de la qualité de nos approvisionnements.

Vous aurez l’opportunité d’intervenir sur un panel de fournisseurs varié, sur des produits et composants aux caractéristiques et finalités différentes, sur des contraintes normatives fortes pour certains composants et de contribuer directement à l’amélioration de la performance industrielle et de la satisfaction de nos clients.

Vos principales missions

  • Qualifier et évaluer les nouveaux fournisseurs : audits, analyse des capacités industrielles et des systèmes qualité, validation des dossiers fournisseurs ;

  • Organiser et suivre les FAI et la validation des pièces et composants ;

  • Piloter la performance qualité des fournisseurs à travers les indicateurs, audits, non-conformités et retours d’expérience ;

  • Identifier et piloter les actions correctives et préventives avec les fournisseurs et en suivre l’efficacité ;

  • Accompagner les fournisseurs dans l’amélioration de leurs procédés et de leur système qualité ;

  • Suivre les dérogations et garantir la conformité et la traçabilité des documents qualité fournisseurs ;

  • Participer aux revues techniques et à la définition des exigences qualité avec les équipes internes et les fournisseurs ;

  • Assurer le reporting de la performance qualité fournisseurs et proposer les actions d’amélioration nécessaires.


De formation supérieure en qualité, ingénierie ou domaine technique, vous disposez d’une première expérience significative de 10 ans minimum en qualité fournisseurs dans un environnement industriel.

Vous maîtrisez les principes de l’audit qualité, de l’analyse des non-conformités et du pilotage des actions correctives.

Vous êtes à l’aise dans l’analyse de données et la résolution de problèmes et savez travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés, aussi bien en interne qu’auprès de fournisseurs.

Votre capacité à analyser, challenger et accompagner les fournisseurs vous permet de construire des relations de travail efficaces tout en maintenant un niveau d’exigence élevé.

Autonome, rigoureux(se) et pragmatique, vous appréciez les environnements dans lesquels la qualité se construit au plus près du terrain.

Des déplacements ponctuels chez nos fournisseurs sont à prévoir.

data.title: Cross-Functional Mechanical Engineer
data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.


We want you as a Cross-Functional Mechanical Engineer to bring hands-on structural design experience and sound engineering judgement to the mechanical development and verification of Nyx. With a strong system-level mindset, you will support subsystem teams in developing robust designs, resolving mechanical challenges, and substantiating the integrity of critical hardware throughout the development lifecycle.

A key focus of your role will be to develop and consolidate the mechanical justifications supporting NASA requirements compliance and Safety Review Panel (SRP) activities. Working with subsystem owners and the safety and certification teams, you will establish the technical basis for allowable damage and failure criteria across critical vehicle components. You will combine direct technical contributions with practical guidance to engineers and suppliers, connecting component-level assessments with vehicle-level requirements and safety considerations.

You will be part of the Nyx Design Office Team, within the Cross-Functional Mechanical team, and will report to the Integrated Mechanical Sizing & Assurance Team Leader.


Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Integration

  • Provide hands-on structural design expertise and technical guidance across subsystems, supporting mechanical integrity and consistency at vehicle level.

  • Assess load paths, interfaces, stiffness, and boundary conditions to understand how mechanical, pressure, and thermo-mechanical loads are transferred through components, attachments, and the vehicle structure.

  • Perform and review mechanical assessments using engineering calculations, finite element analysis (FEA), and test evidence, challenging assumptions and identifying the failure modes that drive design decisions.

  • Support subsystem owners in translating high-level mechanical requirements into subsystem and component specifications, maintaining traceability and accounting for vehicle-level interactions.

Compliance & Verification

  • Develop and document mechanical justifications for allowable damage and failure criteria for critical Nyx hardware, in collaboration with the relevant subsystem and discipline specialists.

  • Establish the supporting rationale through analysis and test evidence, addressing relevant strength, stability, fatigue, fracture, damage tolerance, and residual performance considerations as applicable to each component.

  • Support NASA SRP activities by preparing mechanical justification, contributing to compliance matrices and verification evidence, and addressing technical questions and review actions with the safety and certification teams.

  • Review qualification strategies, test plans, and reports for consistency with applicable NASA requirements, agreed standards, and the assumptions used in mechanical analyses.

  • Participate in design reviews, identify gaps in mechanical justification, and recommend design changes or additional verification activities to resolve them.

Supplier Interactions and Team Collaboration

  • Review supplier designs, structural analyses, and verification documentation to assess technical maturity and consistency with subsystem and vehicle requirements at key milestones.

  • Provide practical technical guidance to suppliers and subsystem owners, resolving mechanical issues and following technical actions through to closure.

  • Facilitate technical alignment between subsystem teams, structural analysis, materials and processes, testing, safety and certification, and suppliers, ensuring that assumptions, interfaces, and responsibilities are clearly understood.

What We Would Love to See from You

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant practical experience.

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in mechanical or structural engineering within the aerospace or aeronautics industry.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and justifying structural or mechanical hardware through development and qualification, in aerospace or aeronautics.

  • Experience assessing relevant failure mechanisms and developing defensible mechanical justifications, including damage acceptance or failure criteria for safety-critical hardware.

  • Ability to perform and critically review engineering calculations and FEA, interpret CAD models and engineering drawings, and relate analysis assumptions to the physical design and test configuration.

  • Understanding of mechanical requirements flow-down, qualification and verification processes, and traceable compliance evidence, together with familiarity with applicable space standards and NASA requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to guide engineers and suppliers through complex mechanical problems while considering subsystem interfaces and vehicle-level consequences.

Additional experience we would value:

  • Direct involvement in NASA safety reviews or SRP submissions, particularly the preparation and defence of mechanical qualification and the closure of review actions.

  • Experience with pressurized structures, fluid piping, radiators, or propulsion hardware, and with fracture control, damage tolerance, or structural test campaigns.

Skills and Behaviors:

  • System-Level Thinking: Ability to connect component-level design and failure mechanisms with subsystem interfaces, vehicle performance, and safety objectives.

  • Engineering Judgement: Ability to identify governing load paths and failure modes, challenge modelling assumptions, and distinguish between a numerical result and a sound mechanical justification.

  • Influence & Decision-Making: Ability to guide technical decisions across teams and suppliers through clear reasoning and evidence, while working within agreed technical responsibilities.

  • Mentorship: Ability to share practical design experience and help engineers strengthen their structural understanding and verification practices.

  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to work constructively with internal teams, suppliers, and external reviewers, including NASA, in coordination with the safety and certification teams.

  • Problem-Solving: Proactive in identifying mechanical risks, prioritizing substantiation gaps, and developing proportionate solutions that protect technical integrity and program objectives.

  • Communication: Clear and structured communicator, able to explain assumptions, load paths, failure criteria, and supporting evidence to different technical audiences.

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Vision, Competence, Integrity and Passion.

  • Fluent in English. Knowledge of German, French and Italian is an asset.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

data.title: AI Scientist - Agentic Engineering - AI4Engineering - (Internship, Masters or PhD)
data.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Mistral is looking for an intern to support AI4Engineering Science in expanding what Mistral's agentic tools can do across the engineering lifecycle, spanning CAE (CAD, CFD, FEA, etc.) and EDA/Semi.

Within the team, your core work is helping build the pre- and post-training data for Mistral's LLMs to reason about and execute real engineering tasks. Alongside this, you'll help shape the agent architectures and harnesses that let these models operate reliably inside multi-step engineering workflows, not just answer isolated questions.

You'll work closely with domain experts across CAE and EDA to ground this work in how engineers actually work, and with the broader research team to translate that domain grounding into training signal and evaluation benchmarks that measure genuine task competence.

This internship is aimed at candidates in the late stages of a Master's degree or a PhD.

What You Will Do

  • Help design pretraining, SFT, and RL data for engineering tasks across CAD, CAE, and semiconductor/EDA

  • Help define verifiers and evaluation criteria that capture what "correct" and "high-quality" actually mean for each engineering task, beyond surface-level plausibility

  • Contribute to agent architectures and harnesses: how models plan, call tools, recover from errors, and chain steps together across long-horizon engineering workflows

  • Build evaluation benchmarks and diagnostic tooling to identify where models fail on engineering tasks, and trace those failures back to gaps in data, reward design, or agent scaffolding

  • Collaborate with domain experts across CAE and EDA (and the science and solutions teams more broadly) to identify which engineering workflows are highest-value to target next

What We're Looking For

  • Currently completing the final year of a Master's degree or in the late stages of a PhD in AI, machine learning, or an engineering discipline

  • Fluent English with excellent communication skills, able to explain technical ML and engineering concepts to both engineering and non-technical audiences

  • Solid, hands-on machine learning expertise, particularly LLM development (e.g. through research projects, coursework, or open-source work)

  • Some experience running, debugging, or validating real engineering workflows in at least one of CAD, CAE, semiconductor simulation, or EDA

  • You write clean, readable Python code and are comfortable in Linux/HPC environments

  • Self-directed: you don't need detailed roadmaps to make progress

  • Low-ego, collaborative, and eager to learn at the intersection of engineering and ML

It would be great if you

  • Have experience building or fine-tuning agentic systems (tool use, multi-step planning, agent orchestration frameworks)

  • Have experience with reward modeling, RLHF/RLAIF/RLVR, or preference-based training

  • Have academic or project experience with CAE or EDA tools (e.g. OpenFOAM, SU2, FreeCAD,OpenCourant, SolidWorks, CATIA, Fluent, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, STAR-CCM+, Cadence/Synopsys/Siemens EDA tools)

  • Have contributed to an open-source or industry codebase

  • Have publications or preprints in engineering and ML venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, JFM, AIAA, etc.)

What We Offer

You will join a dynamic, collaborative research team working at the frontier of agentic AI for engineering, with direct mentorship from senior AI Scientists, access to frontier models and large-scale compute, and the opportunity to contribute to published research and real products.

data.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an AI Deployment Strategist you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral’s AI models, working closely with customers from strategic vision through production implementation.

This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise, business strategy, and hands-on deployment. Specializing in robotics, you will help customers connect Mistral’s models with robotic systems, operational workflows, and existing technical infrastructure.

You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps for robotics, collaborate with Mistral’s technical teams to deliver production solutions, and ensure smooth transitions from pre-sales to post-sales; with a focus on large enterprises. Your job is to understand modern robotics systems well enough, including their capabilities, constraints, and deployment realities and link them to customers hardest challenges and guide them and our technical teams to successful outcomes.

Where robotics stands at Mistral today: we focus on delivering the best robotics models on the field, going beyond research to unlock concrete ROI. We work on the intelligence layer only. We integrate with incumbent robot platforms, we do not build robots. We work through research partnerships and pilots with industrial customers, not an off the shelf product. . We customise our models with manufacturers on their own floor via data capture and fine-tuning to reach best scalable results.

This role is ideal for those who thrive in a fast paced environment, enjoy solving complex technical challenges in robotics, and are passionate about turning AI science into real world impact. You will be based in Paris, co-located with the science team and our robotics lab, working closely with our Singapore hub, and traveling 30-60%.

What You Will Do

Strategic discovery and vision setting

  • Lead executive level workshops to identify robotics specific business challenges and opportunities where Mistral’s AI can drive step change improvements for industrial manufacturing.

  • Translate customer priorities into practical robotics use cases across areas such as industrial automation, manipulation, inspection, navigation, and human–robot interaction.

  • Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the “art of the possible” and a clear path to value. Define a progression from initial experimentation to deployment in real operating environments.

  • Partner with Account Executives to develop business cases, quantify ROI, and align solutions with customer objectives.

  • Help customers prioritize robotics use cases based on value, feasibility, data availability, operational readiness, and deployment risk.

AI and robotics solution deployment

  • Architect an end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral’s models and platform into customer manufacturing workflows and technical infrastructure.

  • Determine how these solutions should interact with customers’ robotic systems, software, data pipelines, and operational processes.

  • Partner with the Applied AI and Science teams to design, prototype, and deploy roboticssolutions in production, ensuring scalability and impact.

  • Own pilots and proofs of value, demonstrating the technology’s potential and paving the way for full-scale deployments.

  • Guide deployment at scale on diverse infrastructure (on-premise, edge, cloud) to ensure that proposed solutions account for real world constraints such as latency, reliability, safety, connectivity, hardware limitations, and changing operating conditions.

Value realization and customer success

  • Serve as a trusted advisor, guiding customer robotics strategy and ensuring maximum value from Mistral’s solutions.

  • Monitor and communicate outcome-driven KPIs, on both science hypothesis and business impact, with executive sponsors.

  • Identify and address barriers to deployment, including process changes, user adoption, governance, integration ownership, and operational readiness.

  • Proactively identify expansion opportunities within accounts, building on initial wins to drive long-term partnerships. This may include expanding deployments to additional workflows, sites, or robotic platforms.

Cross functional collaboration

  • Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral’s Research and Applied AI teams, synthesizing feedback to influence science focused product and research roadmaps.

  • Translate between customer business leaders, robotics specialists, software teams, operational teams, and Mistral’s technical experts.

  • Coordinate multidisciplinary projects involving AI models, robotics software, customer infrastructure, and external technology partners.

  • Create reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks to scale go-to-market efforts and ensure consistent delivery excellence. This includes reference approaches for robotics discovery, piloting, evaluation, and deployment.

  • Contribute to Mistral’s robotics GTM strategy by sharing market insights, customer needs, and deployment learnings.

  • Travel approximately 30 - 60% to foster deep client relationships and support onsite deployment.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years in a client facing strategic and technical role, for example deployment strategy, solutions architecture, value engineering, technical sales, or applied science, with hands on exposure to robotics or industrial automation.

  • Real depth in robotics, not just an interest. You can talk perception, planning, navigation, manipulation, control, simulation, and human-robot interaction, and you know where vision-language-action models fit and where they don't. You don't need to be a researcher, but you need to be credible with robotics engineers and with our VLA roadmap

  • Strong background in AI science domains (computer vision, robotics, embodied AI, etc.), you hold a degree in a scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Robotics, Physics, Mathematics) - PhD is a plus. You are aware of recent model architectures in robotics, like VLM/VLA, you are able to understand where they fit. You don't need to be a researcher, but you need to be credible with robotics engineers and with our science roadmap.

  • Deep technical knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science with specialization in science domains, and the credibility to advise highly technical audiences

  • Experience shaping or delivering technology projects in physical or operational environments.

  • Comfortable working with robotics engineers and understanding integration constraints across hardware, software, data, and infrastructure.

  • Strong business acumen and structured problem solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value

  • Executive presence and strong communication skills with VP and C-level stakeholders on technically advanced solutions.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python).

  • Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment.

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and coordinating multidisciplinary teams across business, AI, software, robotics, and operations.

  • Experience with research-to-production transitions and working with research teams is a plus

Nice to have

  • Experience deploying robotics, industrial automation, computer vision, or edge-AI solutions.

  • Familiarity with robotics platforms, middleware, or simulation environments such as ROS, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or equivalent technologies.

  • Exposure to manufacturing, logistics, automotive, aerospace, energy, construction, or other robotics intensive industries.

  • Understanding of robotics data collection, evaluation, simulation, and sim-to-real considerations.

  • A track record taking a robotics or AI application from prototype to production.

  • Experience working with research, engineering, systems-integration, and industrial partner ecosystems.

  • Experience with hardware OEMs, integrators, or industrial procurement on the customer side.

     

Why This Role Matters

You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring that Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact.

Robotics is moving from narrowly programmed machines toward more adaptive systems powered by foundation models. Turning that potential into customer outcomes requires more than strong models: it requires clear use-case prioritization, thoughtful integration, realistic deployment plans, and close coordination between business, AI, robotics, and operational teams.

You will help customers navigate this transition, translating strategic ambition into production-ready robotics solutions while ensuring that Mistral’s technology addresses real operational needs.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.
 
We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to join our DataFetch Team. 

What the team does

 DataFetch owns the engine behind every view in Pigment: how users access, explore and display their data. Our mission is to give end users fast, easy access to their data in whatever way suits them, and to give modelers the tools to build views that are robust and performant.
 We take block data (metrics, lists, tables) and turn it into what a view actually shows: preparing the query (pivot, scope, filters, aggregations), applying access rights, and shaping results ready to render.

Why it matters

 Views and boards are how most people consume Pigment. Every grid opened, every export run and every drilldown goes through DataFetch, so our work shapes the daily experience of both end users and modelers. And increasingly, agents and AI features rely on us as the data-access layer to retrieve customer data.

What you'll do
 
- Pitch our product to existing and new customers and collect their feedback through workshops, design sessions, UX research and discovery, together with other PMs and Designers
- Build the product vision and roadmap in close collaboration with Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing and Sales; secure the flows of communication between those teams so that everyone has the necessary support and information for customer communication and day to day prioritization

Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

What you will do

1. Build and run automations with AI

  • Automate the employee lifecycle: build, test, deploy and maintain workflows for recruiting-to-onboarding handoffs, employee changes, learning administration and offboarding.

  • Connect the People stack: move data reliably between Pigment and the other People tools (performance, learning, ticketing), using various automation tools, APIs and webhooks.

  • Translate process into logic: sit with People process owners, map how work happens today, and turn it into clean workflows with triggers, conditions, approvals, notifications and error handling.

  • Handle failure safely: design for missing data, unavailable systems and unexpected inputs, and route exceptions to the right owner instead of failing silently.

  • Run what you ship: monitor production workflows, investigate failures and fix recurring issues at the root, and align with the Data & Automation team.

2. Build AI agents and self-service 

  • Build People agents: use LLMs and Pigment's native AI capabilities to build agents that answer employee and manager questions, draft responses and route tickets.

  • Prompt and evaluate: write prompts and agent instructions, build test cases, and measure answer accuracy, source quality and appropriate escalation. Keep a versioned library of approved prompts and results.

  • Connect approved knowledge only: link agents to the right sources for each audience, and make sure sensitive or unresolved questions go to a person.

  • Test the market: pilot new AI features and tools, and move them to production when relevant.

  • Spot new opportunities: bring workflow and agent ideas from People teams to the People Strategy & Tech Lead, with a first view of effort and value.

3. Document, monitor and improve 

  • Treat People workflow like product code: keep clear documentation, schemas and runbooks for every workflow and agent: purpose, dependencies, logic, owner, monitoring and change history.

  • Keep an inventory: maintain an up-to-date list of the automations, agents, integrations and prompts you support, and retire what no longer works.

  • Measure service health: track success rate, processing time, answer quality, escalation rate and incidents, and report them to the People Strategy & Tech Lead regularly.

  • Apply responsible AI controls: implement the access, data and human-review requirements defined by Security, Privacy and Legal, and re-test after any model, data or configuration change.

  • Support adoption: write short guides and release notes, and help People teams use what you build.

  • Work within company standards: build with the stack and follow the IT and security guidelines set by the Data & Automation team, and document your work so others can support it when you are away.

Who you are

  • Experience: 2+ years in AI implementations, automations, data or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growing tech or SaaS company. No HR background needed: what matters is that you have built something real that others rely on, and that you want to turn People into an AI-powered team. Internships and apprenticeships count if you ship real things.

  • The builder mindset: you have built workflows or integrations that other people actually use, with tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make, Workato or Power Automate. Scripting (SQL, Python or JavaScript) or expert-level spreadsheet logic is a strong plus.

  • AI-fluent: you know how to prompt LLMs, you have built or tested an agent or an AI assistant, and you are excited to replace repetitive human steps with reliable automation.

  • Systems thinking: you understand APIs, webhooks, structured data, permissions and conditional logic, and you know how automated services fail.

  • People curiosity: you understand or you are interested in core HR processes (hiring, onboarding, internal mobility, offboarding, payroll inputs) and can turn a process owner's needs into system logic.

  • Judgment with sensitive data: you have worked with sensitive or confidential information (financial, legal, customer or personal data) and handle it with care, and you know when a human must stay in the loop.

  • Clear communicator: you explain technical choices and trade-offs to non-technical partners, and you document as you go.

  • Education: degree in engineering, data, information systems, business school with a focus on BI or information systems. Self-taught builders with strong evidence of work are welcome.

  • Fluency in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience automating or deploying AI inside an HR or People team.

  • Hands-on time with HiBob, Lever or similar HRIS and ATS tools, or with a ticketing and knowledge-base tool.

  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent evaluation or AI-assisted development tools.

  • Experience working with Security, Privacy or Legal teams, or knowledge of GDPR and responsible AI in employment processes.


What success looks like in the first 12 months

  • Priority automations live in production, each with a measurable drop in manual work, processing time or errors.

  • Self-service agent launched with tested answer quality, approved sources and clear escalation paths.

  • A versioned library of prompts, test cases and evaluation results for approved People use cases.

  • Monitoring, documentation and runbooks in place for every workflow and agent you support.

  • Automated data-quality checks catching missing, late or inconsistent data and routing it to an owner.

  • A regular service-health view for the People Strategy & Tech Lead: success rate, incidents, adoption and open improvements.

Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.

data.title: Senior B2B Event Manager
data.description:
Who are we?

moka.care is a mental health solution for companies, with one mission in mind: nurturing healthy minds to foster healthy organizations.

We guide employees through individual and group therapy or coaching sessions.

Alongside we help HR teams to take care of their employees’ mental health on a daily basis.

Where we are currently: Since our creation in December 2019, more than 400 companies (L'Oreal, Spendesk, Qonto, Engie, Castalie, etc.) have joined moka.care, and we now have over 300,000 employees covered in France but also throughout the world!

We have raised 17,5 million euros and are 70 to help companies improve their mental well-being.

What we believe in? Excellence in care is our obsession.

Culture is not nice words we put on the walls, we have defined 4 tangible values to make this culture live: Team Play, Optimism, Ownership & Agility.


Why do we need you?

We’re looking for a Senior B2B Event Manager to imagine and lead events that raise Moka.Care’s profile among decision-makers and clients.

Your priorities will be to evolve our presence at external events, bring Moka.Care’s own events to life, and build a new premium events strategy. You’ll help create meaningful connections, generate new opportunities and strengthen relationships with our clients around a topic that matters: mental health at work.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you’ll work closely with the Marketing, Sales and Customer Care teams, as well as our founders and experts.


Your Responsibilities:

1. Evolve our presence at external events

  • Lead our participation in trade shows, conferences and other professional events, including format selection, budgets, vendors, logistics and team coordination.
  • Challenge our approach to the events we already attend and suggest new ways to participate.
  • Identify new events and opportunities to meet decision-makers, including in sectors we know less well.
  • Negotiate with organizers to secure terms and visibility aligned with our objectives.

    • 2. Bring our own events to life and develop them

  • Build a premium events strategy: imagine and organize lunches, conferences and carefully curated experiences for our clients.
  • Suggest formats tailored to different sectors and audiences, working with teams who understand their needs.
  • Lead each event end to end, from concept to the day itself: objectives, budget, vendors, invitations and speaker coordination.
  • Take ownership of and continue to develop our existing events, including Moka’s quarterly HR leaders’ club (TCC) and summer party, to foster exchanges within our community of HR decision-makers.

    • 3. Measure impact and coordinate follow-up

  • Build and manage the events calendar and budget, agreeing on priorities with the Head of Marketing.
  • Define appropriate metrics for each event and use the results to recommend improvements to the program.
  • Organize the sharing and follow-up of contacts with the Sales and Customer Care teams, who own relationships with prospects and clients. Ensure actions are tracked in the CRM.

    • Events will remain at the heart of the role. You may represent Moka.Care at certain events and help facilitate speaking opportunities for our teams, but hosting conferences will not be a core responsibility.


    You’re the ideal person if:

    The essentials

  • You have at least six years of experience in B2B events involving decision-makers, whether in the HR space or another sector.
  • You have managed events end to end and can handle multiple projects, a budget and external partners with rigor.
  • You can take a step back to assess an existing program, suggest fresh ideas and turn them into tangible events.
  • You’re comfortable coordinating a range of stakeholders, negotiating and communicating with decision-makers.
  • You connect your work to clear objectives and know how to analyze results in collaboration with the relevant teams.
  • You’re proactive, autonomous, organized and attentive to detail. You want to help advance mental health at work.

    • Nice to have

  • Knowledge of the HR events ecosystem or a network of HR decision-makers and organizers.
  • Experience creating company-hosted events, premium formats or building communities.
  • Experience with a CRM, particularly HubSpot, or with public speaking at events.

    • Joining us you will

    • Participate in an entrepreneurial fast-growing adventure and the possibility of having a huge potential for evolution inside moka
    • See the concrete impact of your efforts each day and participate in nurturing healthy minds to foster healthy organizations
    • Grow as a person and learn within a team of great people
    • Be trusted: we hire great talents who lead us to the next level

    We'll take care of you

    • Access to Moka.Care: selfcare, individual & group sessions, and the possibility to test the new features in preview
    • Benefit Fund - May : up to 1500€ net / year (125€ net / month)
    • BSPCE for everyone
    • Work life balance: 60% at the office - 2 days per week or 1 week per month remotely
    • Swile Meal voucher card of 10€/day (restaurants, groceries and food apps)
    • Gymlib for sport & wellness allowance
    • Transportation allowance (50% reimbursed)
    • 7 week holiday policy (& one additional day off per year)

    Interview Process

    • Phone interview 
    • Background Interview
    • A Case study and job focused interview to project yourself in your future day-to-day job
    • And finally a Value fit interview to make sure you’ll feel comfortable at moka
    • Offer and reverse interview
    If needed we organize other informal talks like coffee with the team.
     
    Moka.Care is a disability-friendly company.

As the Director of Sales Engineering, Southern Europe you will take a senior role in shaping how we engage with customers, partners, and the wider sales organisation. You will lead a small team of Sales Engineers, guiding their development and ensuring they are well equipped to succeed, while continuing to spend most of your time working directly on high value opportunities.

This is a senior hands on leadership role. You will set technical direction for key accounts, influence deal strategy, and help resolve complex architectural questions. You will act as a trusted advisor to customers and sales teams, while also representing the SE function in regional planning, forecasting, and cross functional discussions.

You will lead by example, taking ownership of strategic opportunities and stepping in where your experience can make a meaningful difference to outcomes. At the same time, you will coach your team to grow their own expertise and confidence, creating an environment where they can perform at a high level.

Main Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and support a team of Sales Engineers (SE's), providing coaching, regular feedback, and career development
  • Set clear expectations for technical quality, customer engagement, and opportunity execution
  • Help onboard and mentor new team members and strengthen consistent ways of working across the region
  • Partner with regional sales leadership to ensure SE resources are aligned with priority accounts
  • Maintain a healthy, collaborative team culture

  • Deliver solution demonstrations, discovery sessions, technical guidance, RFx responses, and proofs of concept
  • Guide technical strategy across multiple deals
  • Act as an escalation point for technical challenges during critical deal phases

  • Work closely with sales teams throughout qualification, discovery, and technical proof phases
  • Coordinate pre sales efforts with post sales delivery teams to ensure smooth handovers and clear expectations
  • Represent Ping Identity at customer meetings, executive briefings, partner events, and industry sessions

Cross Functional Influence

  • Provide insight into market trends, customer challenges, and developing areas.
  • Share well reasoned product feedback with product owners and help shape regional solution positioning
  • Support strategic planning and forecasting discussions with regional sales leadership
  • Work with marketing and product teams to refine competitive messaging and technical narratives

Skills & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience of managing sales engineering teams in France, and preferably also Iberia & Italy
  • Strong understanding of IAM concepts, architectures, and protocols. Experience with standards such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM is helpful
  • Proficiency with REST APIs and JSON, and familiarity with one or more modern programming or scripting languages
  • Solid understanding of core infrastructure technologies, including networking, DNS, HTTP/S, load balancing, proxies, and virtualisation
  • Experience with major cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and deployment technologies like Kubernetes and Terraform
  • Understanding of how customers are using agentic AI and how identity secures AI agents, their permissions, and their behaviour
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and non technical audiences
  • Ability to work independently while also supporting and elevating a team
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities without losing focus on key opportunities
  • A genuine interest in learning and staying current in a fast evolving technical landscape
  • BS in Software Engineering or equivalent degree
  • Fluent French language skills

About We make it GmbH. We make it GmbH is a company operating nationally in Switzerland. Thanks to many years of successful experience, it has a high level of competence in the personnel services sector. Concentration of placement activities on the core areas of industry, technology, office/administration, engineering, pharmaceuticals and IT. We make it GmbH places the highest demands on quality, ethics and discretion.

For our customer, the company Roche Diagnostics, are we searching for:

Test Engineer (m/f/d)

Background

In our department, we focus on Verification & Validation (V&V) across the entire product lifecycle, from early feasibility through product care, covering software, hardware, assays, and consumables, including critical calibration phases. Operating in a fast-paced, regulated environment where setups frequently evolve, you will work hands-on with pre-analytic instruments, manual output modules, and lab transport connections to ensure our diagnostic systems perform reliably under strict timelines.

The Perfect Candidate: You bring a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a mechanical, industrial design, digital engineering, or data science field, or a strong technical education, backed by at least one year of hands-on experience or an internship in hardware component or instrument testing. You possess a true "engineer mindset" with a deep intuitive understanding of how mechanical parts interact, whether gained in MedTech, Pharma/GMP, or other highly regulated sectors like automotive or aviation. You thrive in dynamic setups where priorities shift quickly, using your analytical sharpness to uncover edge-case hardware issues, differentiate between user misuse and actual defects, and collaborate seamlessly with hardware developers in fluent English (with German as a strong plus).

Work hours

Standard / 40h week (Home Office: one day per week max for admin)

Tasks

You write clear, comprehensive test cases and technical requirements based on system specifications and stakeholder input. You execute hands-on test cases and complex test sets (including calibration phases) directly on hardware components, pre-analytic instruments, manual output modules, and lab transport interfaces. You analyze and report test results, meticulously documenting defects, tracking issues, and verifying fixes. You collaborate closely with hardware developers and cross-functional teams to align on component behavior, investigate root causes, and resolve instrument-level issues. You distinguish between actual hardware defects and operational misuse, uncovering edge cases that may not yet be captured in formal specifications. You support the setup and maintenance of compliant test environments and equipment while contributing to continuous process and quality improvements

qualifications

You bring a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related engineering/technical field, or an equivalent completed technical education. You have at least 1 year of relevant hands-on experience (including internships) in hardware component testing, instrument testing, or hardware development. You possess a strong "mechanical engineer mindset", an intuitive understanding of how mechanical and hardware parts interact, whether gained in MedTech, Pharma, Automotive, or Aviation. You have experience working within highly regulated environments (such as GMP, ISO, automotive, or aerospace standards). You bring strong analytical skills to interpret complex test results, identify edge cases beyond written specs, and work reliably under strict timelines. You are fluent in English (written and spoken) and bring a collaborative, flexible team-player attitude ready to navigate frequent changes in test setups

Nice to haves

You bring a multidisciplinary academic or professional background combining mechanical/product design with data or digital engineering (e.g., Data Science, Digital Engineering, or Industrial & Product Design). You have experience using data science or quality metrics to spot trends and identify improvement opportunities in verification results. You are familiar with diagnostic instruments, pre-analytic systems, lab automation/transport connections, or calibration testing. You speak German in addition to English

Are you interested?

Then Mr. Raphael Sigg looks forward to receiving your complete application documents (CV, certificates and training certificates).

We look forward to hearing from you
