data.description:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Audit Senior Specialist

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

You will be the statutory Head of Internal Audit for Nubank's European entity and the primary Internal Audit point of contact for the local regulator. As Nubank builds its regulated European operation, independent assurance is what earns and keeps the trust of the regulator and the governance bodies — you own that from day one.

This is not a role that supervises other people doing the work. It is a full hands-on, build-from-scratch role: for the first 12–18 months you will operate largely on your own, performing and leading the audits yourself, with the support of Nubank's global Internal Audit team and additional resources over time as the function matures. You'll report functionally into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership, preserving Internal Audit's independence and maintaining direct access to the entity's Audit and Risk Committees.

You will build a modern, data-driven audit function — one that leans on automation, analytics and AI rather than traditional checklist auditing — while partnering with a young, fast-scaling business where governance and controls are still being built. Your goal: stand up and run a credible Internal Audit function that gives the Committees and the local regulator confidence that Nubank is growing in a healthy, sustainable way.

You'll be responsible for

  • Acting as the statutory Head of Internal Audit for the European entity, representing Internal Audit before the local regulator and reporting independently into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership and the relevant Committees.

  • Owning the entity's Internal Audit universe and risk assessment — a dynamic view of key risks across products, digital asset initiatives, financial crime, governance and internal-control frameworks.

  • Designing and executing the audit plan, and coordinating closely with Nubank's global Internal Audit function and the hubs in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia.

  • Performing and leading end-to-end audits hands-on — not only scoping and coordinating fieldwork, but often running the testing yourself — covering fintech/digital banking products, digital assets and related infrastructure, AML/financial-crime obligations, and governance, risk and control frameworks.

  • Coordinating Internal Audit's contribution to supervisory interactions with the local regulator, being comfortable explaining clearly what Internal Audit does before any regulator, and proactively communicating emerging risks.

  • Engaging the governance bodies — Audit Committee and Risk Committee — with clear, concise, impact-oriented reporting.

  • Building trust-based relationships with local senior management and second-line risk/compliance partners, operating as a trusted challenger and advisor while preserving Internal Audit's independence.

  • Promoting the use of technology, data and AI in the audit work — continuous auditing routines, data analytics, AI-assisted testing and documentation — to increase coverage and enable predictive risk monitoring.

  • Acting as a culture carrier for Nubank's Internal Audit, keeping the local function fully integrated into the global audit vision and standards.

  • Over time, and consistent with business and regulatory needs, designing, building and leading an appropriately resourced Internal Audit function for the entity.

We are looking for a person who has

Experience and background

  • A solid Internal Audit background in financial services (as an internal or external auditor); senior second-line/compliance profiles are welcome when grounded in prior Internal Audit experience.

  • Experience with the Swiss or European regulatory framework.

  • Meaningful experience in fintech or banking.

  • Experience engaging governance bodies, specifically Audit and Risk Committees.

  • Proven knowledge of fintech/digital-banking business models, AML/financial-crime controls and investigations, and traditional banking products and infrastructure.

Ways of working and skills

  • High ownership and autonomy

  • A genuinely hands-on posture

  • A builder mindset

  • A data-driven approach to audit: experience with data and analytics in audit or risk work; hands-on SQL/Python is a strong plus and a good signal of fit, and a strong appetite to work with data-driven testing is essential.

Cultural openness and humility

  • Ability to analyze end-to-end processes and controls across finance, credit, payments, AML, information security, technology and governance, connecting the details to the overall risk profile.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, explaining complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including regulators and senior executives.

  • Strong stakeholder management — influencing senior leaders, challenging constructively and building trust across the three lines of defense.

  • German is required — the local regulator operates in German and there is no intermediary for regulatory interaction, so working proficiency in German is needed. Fluent English is also required.

Nice to have

  • Experience with digital assets — crypto and stablecoins. (Digital-assets experience is a plus, not a requirement)

  • No specific certification is required (CIA, ACCA, CISA, etc. are welcome but not mandatory).

Location for this opportunity

  • Zug, Switzerland

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Health Insurance Allowance for you and your dependents

  • Pension Plan

  • Accident Insurance

  • Daily Sickness Benefits

  • Life Insurance & Death Benefits

  • NuCare – Employee Assistance Programme, available 24/7 for you and your dependents

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • International Travel Insurance for business trips

  • Work-from-home Allowance and office equipment for working from home

  • Parking space at the Zug office

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

data.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Heavy-Duty Mechanical Engineer on Harmattan AI's Launcher team in Lausanne, you will take a clean-sheet, fully autonomous launch system from a blank sheet of paper all the way to the factory floor and live field deployment.

Our Launcher team builds the ruggedised, autonomous deployment infrastructure that takes our larger platforms from storage to flight at a moment's notice. Operating in a fast-paced startup environment within a tight-knit, cross-functional squad (alongside a Team Lead, another Mechanical Engineer, a Hardware Engineer, and a Software Engineer), you will act as an end-to-end technical owner. Your work spans defining system specifications, sizing heavy structures and high-acceleration systems, managing budgets and suppliers, and getting hands-on in the workshop and field to stress-test hardware to failure.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Clean-Sheet Design: Architect, design, and prototype ruggedized, unmanned launch systems from scratch, taking hardware from initial concept through field test rigs to deployable systems.

Our Launcher team builds the ruggedized, unmanned deployment infrastructure that takes our larger autonomous platforms from storage to flight at a moment's notice. Operating in a fast-paced startup environment within a tight-knit, cross-functional squad, you will own the entire control, automation, and safety architecture end-to-end.

About Divio

Divio is a remote-first company spread across Europe. Our core product is a multi-cloud Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) for deploying and managing web applications, used by agencies, developers, and enterprises who want to move fast without DevOps overhead. Alongside our platform, we provide application development and support services to a select group of key enterprise accounts. They rely on us not just for their infrastructure, but also to build, evolve, and support the applications that run on it. Because we run the platform as well as the code, we own the whole chain from development to production.

The role

You will join a small cross-functional team working on a large, multi-site enterprise application, building re-usable frontend components and complete user-facing features, implementing tools, integrating external services and creating features and functionality that are used across multiple sites and audiences.  You will work closely with our backend and infrastructure engineers, our platform team, and the clients themselves. 


Your work will include:

  • Building features: designing and developing modern, maintainable frontends for client applications, mainly in React and TypeScript.
  • Owning quality: keeping client codebases healthy, secure, accessible, and performant over the long term, not just shipping and moving on.
  • Working with clients: turning requirements into practical solutions, giving estimates, and explaining technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Deploying: taking your work from development to production on the Divio platform and on AWS.

  • Shaping how we work: contributing to frontend standards, reviews and tooling across the project, and having a say in our quarterly objectives.

Requirements

Who we're looking for

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 7+ years of professional frontend experience, with strong React and TypeScript skills
  • Is comfortable with Node.js
  • Has an excellent understanding of HTML, CSS, Accessibility and web performance

Nice to have:

  • Experience in Static site generation (Gatsby, Next.js, Astro, …)

In short

We're a small team of passionate engineers working on an exciting product and on interesting, challenging projects for our clients. You get freedom in how you work and responsibility for what goes live. There are real challenges, and plenty of chances to learn, improve things and make an impact on the applications we build, on our platform, and on how we work as a team.

data.title: Head of Support (m/f/d) – Fully Remote
data.description:
Location: fully remote, work from anywhere

About what. AG

what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. We build websites, e-commerce and growth marketing for Swiss SMEs — and we’re pushing hard into AI-driven delivery, from our own Support Agent to our what. growth product. We’re a small, senior, remote team that likes to work smart and automate the repetitive parts.

About the role

Support has grown into one of our core services — service-agreement clients, our AI Support Agent, and on-demand project management. We’re looking for one person to own it end-to-end: the vision, the processes, the quality, the team and the commercials — and to push how far we can take AI in support. You turn a growing, multi-part operation into one well-led, measurable, continuously improving service.

How we work

You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class support to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. And we’re AI-first: we automate the repetitive parts and use AI as a core tool every day, so the team can focus on judgement and quality.


What you’ll do

  • Own Support end-to-end — set the vision, priorities and best practices, and give the function clear direction.

  • Run and level up our processes and AI — continuously improve all support processes, including our AI Support Agent; keep them documented, train the team, own security & compliance.

  • Lead the team — empower Support Managers, WordPress developers, the on-demand PM and specialists; strong ticket and incident management and a culture of continuous learning.

  • Drive quality and delivery — define and track SA quality and delivery metrics (client satisfaction, return rate, response and completion times) and report to management.

  • Be a trusted partner to key SA clients — foster up- and cross-selling and act as relationship manager; you think about their business, not just their tickets.

  • Keep an eye on budget and profitability — invoicing, contribution margin and cost-saving measures, with support from our finance team.

  • Handle continuity and crises — prepare for and manage outages and security incidents calmly.

Key & Essential Skills

  • Ideally 5+ years in support, service delivery or technical account management (digital/web agency or hosting/WordPress environment), including experience leading a small team.

  • Solid technical grasp of WordPress, hosting and uptime/security monitoring — you don’t code, but you speak the language and can steer technical work.

  • A strong process thinker genuinely excited to take our use of AI in support to the next level.

  • Commercial sense — comfortable with invoicing, budgets and contribution margin.

  • Native Language German and Fluent English (our working language) is required

  • Comfortable with written-only communication (tickets, email, chat); this role has no phone support.

What makes you a fit

  • You take ownership and see things through.

  • You stay calm and structured under pressure — incidents and outages don’t rattle you.

  • You give honest feedback, to clients and to us.

  • You think like an entrepreneur: curious, commercially minded, always moving forward.

Perks

  • Fully remote — work from anywhere. (Our Seefeld office in Zurich is there if you’re local.)

  • Real responsibility and influence — and a team that has your back. See something to improve? Speak up, we’re listening.

  • Flexible hours and a flat hierarchy — results-oriented, no micromanaging.

  • A multicultural team that learns together, including daily hands-on work with AI tools like Claude.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays.

  • Fair compensation and profit participation.

  • Personal development opportunities — e.g. in 2026 we sent 10 people to Tony Robbins’ UPW event.

How to Apply

  • Apply via our website with your CV and a short intro video (2–3 min, in German or English — whichever you’re most comfortable in; e.g. Loom or YouTube): tell us what drew you to this role and share an example where you improved a support operation or led a team through a tough incident.

  • 👉 Applications without a video or sent via other channels (e.g. email or social media) won’t be considered.

data.title: Senior Category Lead Modern Art
Customer Marketing Manager, EMEA
data.description:
Horizon3.ai is seeking a customer-focused, data-driven Customer Marketing Manager to build engagement, adoption, retention, expansion, and advocacy across our EMEA customer base. You will create programs that help customers realize more value from Horizon3, strengthen customer relationships, and turn successful outcomes into credible customer proof.

This role brings together customer lifecycle marketing and customer advocacy. You will develop regional customer communications and campaigns while building a repeatable advocacy engine across customer stories, references, third-party reviews, speakers, and other strategic opportunities. You will work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, and the broader Marketing team to turn customer needs and business priorities into useful, measurable programs.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic planner and a hands-on operator. You can build trust with customers, coordinate complex projects across teams and markets, use data to improve programs, and make it straightforward for customers to participate.

What you will do

Customer lifecycle marketing

  • Plan and execute customer marketing programs across onboarding, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, renewal support, and expansion.

  • Define customer segments, lifecycle stages, journey maps, messaging, and campaign playbooks that can be adapted for EMEA audiences.

  • Partner with Customer Success and Customer Enablement to promote onboarding, education, product engagement, and other programs that help customers achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Develop proactive re-engagement programs for at-risk or under-engaged accounts using customer health, product usage, support, engagement, and renewal signals.

  • Create signal-based campaigns tied to customer needs, product usage, account changes, renewal timing, and expansion fit. Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate Customer Success Managers and account executives.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to translate customer feedback into product communications, release messaging, educational content, and lifecycle campaigns.

  • Equip Sales and Customer Success with customer-centric messaging, adoption resources, executive business review materials, playbooks, and clear follow-up paths.

Customer advocacy and proof

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of EMEA customer advocates based on customer outcomes, engagement, use cases, and willingness to participate.

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers and account teams to identify customers for case studies, video testimonials, customer quotes, social content, references, and events.

  • Manage customer participation from outreach through briefing, approvals, production, publication, and follow-up. Coordinate logo rights, quotes, and other customer permissions with the appropriate internal teams.

  • Create and manage a practical customer reference program that supports sales opportunities, renewals, expansions, and strategic marketing needs. Maintain an organized reference pool and manage requests from intake and matching through scheduling, follow-up, and recognition.

  • Own day-to-day Peerbound administration and adoption, including customer profiles, advocacy requests, reference activity, permissions, and reporting. Help Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success use the platform consistently and make fuller use of its capabilities.

  • Develop and execute a focused third-party review strategy across relevant platforms, such as G2 and Gartner Peer Insights. Coordinate authentic customer outreach and track review volume, ratings, sentiment, category placement, competitor positioning, and progress against award criteria.

  • Maintain a qualified pipeline of customer speakers for webinars, user groups, events, panels, and other marketing programs. Confirm speakers early enough to include them in event promotions, landing pages, emails, and social campaigns, and manage briefing, preparation, logistics, approvals, and follow-up.

  • Own the customer invitation process for Customer Advisory Board opportunities and support customer recruitment for analyst interviews, research, awards, and other strategic initiatives.

  • Work with Content, Product Marketing, Social, Events, Communications, Analyst Relations, and Creative to elevate customers alongside the Horizon3.ai brand and turn customer outcomes into reusable marketing assets.

Program operations and measurement

  • Build annual and quarterly customer marketing plans for EMEA, manage budgets and resources, and lead cross-functional execution.

  • Work with Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success Operations to improve segmentation, data quality, trigger detection, nurture, automation, attribution, and reporting.

  • Establish dashboards and operating rhythms that connect program engagement to adoption, customer advocacy, renewal health, retention, expansion pipeline, and influenced revenue.

  • Define success measures, analyze results, identify opportunities to improve, and iterate on program strategy, messaging, and execution.

  • Communicate timelines, owners, status, risks, and next steps clearly across teams. Create practical templates, trackers, and workflows that make customer marketing easier to execute and scale.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, customer advocacy, customer success enablement, or a related discipline.

  • Experience building customer journeys and programs across adoption, engagement, retention, renewal, expansion, or advocacy.

  • A track record of managing customer stories, references, reviews, speakers, or other advocacy programs, ideally alongside lifecycle marketing responsibilities.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and confidence communicating with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Marketing Operations, and Revenue Operations.

  • Strong project management and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple programs and deadlines across teams and markets.

  • Analytical and operational skills, including the ability to connect customer behavior and program performance to business outcomes.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the judgment to represent customer perspectives accurately and authentically.

  • Familiarity with customer advocacy, reference, review, CRM, or marketing automation platforms. Peerbound experience is a plus.

  • Understanding of B2B SaaS or cybersecurity customer environments is a plus.

  • Ability to work effectively across EMEA markets and time zones. Additional language skills are a plus.

How success is measured

  • Lifecycle program engagement and contribution to customer adoption, retention, renewal health, and expansion.

  • Growth and health of the EMEA customer advocate and reference pool, including references fulfilled and customer participation.

  • Customer proof produced, including case studies, videos, quotes, approved logos, and social or event participation.

  • Customer speakers confirmed in time to support event and webinar promotion.

  • Peerbound adoption, data quality, and program activity.

  • Review volume, ratings, sentiment, and progress against award criteria.

  • Customer experience and internal stakeholder satisfaction.

data.title: Elektromonteur (Senior)
data.description:
Bij PromTeg doen we wat we beloven. Geen gedoe, wel strak werk waar je trots op bent.

Je komt terecht in een hechte organisatie van ongeveer 30 collega's waar de lijnen kort zijn en vertrouwen vanzelfsprekend is. Vanuit Uitgeest en Duiven werken we aan multidisciplinaire projecten, service en onderhoud voor grote opdrachtgevers door heel Nederland.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een ervaren vakman die verantwoordelijkheid neemt, collega's verder helpt en een belangrijke rol speelt binnen technische projecten. Je krijgt veel vrijheid in je werk en kunt rekenen op een team dat achter je staat.

Als Elektromonteur (Senior) werk je aan complexe installaties binnen de utiliteit. Je combineert elektrotechnische werkzaamheden met andere technische disciplines en bent een technisch aanspreekpunt voor collega's, projectleiding en klanten op locatie.

Wat wij je bieden

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband

  • Pensioenregeling volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek

  • Ruimte voor opleidingen, trainingen en relevante certificeringen

  • Mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen elektrotechniek, brandmeldinstallaties, beveiligingsinstallaties, netwerken, CCTV, toegangscontrole en gebouwbeheersystemen

  • Een nette bedrijfsbus

  • Werk op projectlocaties door heel Nederland, waarbij je waar mogelijk rechtstreeks vanuit huis naar het project rijdt

  • Extra voordelen via VDKnaken, waaronder korting via Centraal Beheer en Corporate Benefits

Wat ga je doen?

Je start je dag op een projectlocatie waar verschillende technische disciplines samenkomen. Je stemt af met collega's, begeleidt waar nodig minder ervaren monteurs en zorgt dat werkzaamheden technisch goed worden uitgevoerd.

De ene keer werk je aan een nieuw utiliteitsproject, de andere keer aan een uitbreiding of renovatie van een bestaande installatie. Dankzij jouw ervaring zie je snel wat nodig is en denk je actief mee over slimme technische oplossingen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het realiseren, testen en opleveren van elektrotechnische installaties

  • Het aanleggen van bekabeling en aansluiten van componenten en systemen

  • Het uitvoeren van werkzaamheden binnen grote en technisch complexe utiliteitsprojecten

  • Het adviseren van klanten over technische oplossingen op locatie

  • Het fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt binnen projecten

  • Het begeleiden van minder ervaren collega's en delen van vakkennis

  • Het werken aan brandmeldinstallaties, beveiligingsinstallaties, CCTV, netwerken, toegangscontrole en gebouwbeheersystemen, afhankelijk van het project en jouw expertise

Heb je jouw ervaring opgebouwd binnen elektrotechniek, brandmeldtechniek of beveiligingstechniek? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Bij PromTeg krijg je de mogelijkheid om je kennis verder te verbreden en mee te bouwen aan multidisciplinaire projecten.

Wat neem je mee

data.title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
data.description:
Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights.

At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action.

About the role

As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information.

You will:

  • support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities;

  • own and maintain the data model

  • analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights;

  • investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers;

  • build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis;

  • use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use;

  • investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting;

  • help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working;

  • contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes;

  • translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights.

An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights.

Your development in data

Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to:

  • contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals;

  • design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible;

  • integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption);

  • manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture;

  • apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA;

  • map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions;

  • work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques;

  • document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability.

This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control.

Collaboration & positioning

You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective.

Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe.

The role is based at our head office in Almere.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights.

You bring:

  • willingness to learn

  • around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller;

  • solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics);

  • experience with or a strong interest in Power BI;

  • strong analytical skills;

  • the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models;

  • a curious and proactive approach to solving problems;

  • the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working;

  • an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve;

  • a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data;

  • fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable.

  • experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

    Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What we offer

This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used.

You can expect:

  • a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience.

  • an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary; 

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; 

  • a pension scheme; 

  • a commuting allowance; 

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop;

  • structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.

We are HG

HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products.

We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems.

HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance.

We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact.

HG does what it promises.


Do you have any questions?

Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at

Would you like to apply for the junior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days.

Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

data.title: HR-Stagiair(e)
data.description:
Als HR‑Stagiair(e) draai je bij ons mee in het HR‑team en krijg je de kans om veel te leren, met een duidelijke focus op Learning & Development. Je werkt mee aan verschillende HR- en L&D‑activiteiten en krijgt daarnaast de ruimte om je stage zelf vorm te geven en te ontdekken welke andere HR‑onderwerpen jou aanspreken. Zo doe je brede praktijkervaring op in een omgeving waar veel gebeurt en waar je actief kunt bijdragen.


Jouw stage:

Je werkt mee in ons team van 10 HR‑professionals met expertise in o.a. onboarding, L&D, verzuim, recruitment, employer branding en HR‑advies. Je krijgt veel vrijheid én goede begeleiding om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Waar draag je aan bij?

  • Het versterken van vaardigheden en ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie door mee te werken aan L&D‑projecten.

  • Het soepel laten verlopen van soft skills trainingen, door ondersteuning bij voorbereiding, communicatie en coördinatie.

  • De verbetering van HR‑processen door het initiëren en uitvoeren van eigen HR‑projecten (bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van onboarding, recruitment of procesoptimalisatie).

  • Events rondom arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, workshops rond duurzame inzetbaarheid en onboardingsactiviteiten.

  • Een correcte en overzichtelijke HR‑administratie, zoals het opstellen van contracten, brieven en personele mutaties.

  • Continue verbetering binnen HR door actieve deelname aan HR‑overleggen en het meedenken over verbeteringen.

Onze organisatie beweegt snel: er gebeurt veel en geen week is hetzelfde. Dat biedt enorm veel leerkansen, maar vraagt ook dat jij zelf richting geeft aan je stage en je weg vindt in een dynamische omgeving. Je krijgt van ons goede begeleiding, maar het is aan jou om kansen te zien en initiatief te tonen.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken een stagiair(e) die:

  • Een hbo‑opleiding HRM volgt (3e of 4e jaar) en stage wil lopen vanaf februari 2027.

  • Beschikbaar is voor 4 of 5 dagen per week.

  • Geïnteresseerd is in Learning & Development.

  • Sterk is in Nederlands en goed overweg kan met Engels.

  • Nauwkeurig werkt, durft te vragen en zelfstandig durft te handelen.

  • Het leuk vindt om in een dynamische omgeving te werken waar veel gebeurt.

Wij bieden:

  • Stageplek per september 2026 voor 32-40 uur per week.

  • Begeleiding van ervaren HR-professionals.

  • Stagevergoeding van € 650,- per maand op basis van 40 uur.

  • Meedoen met ons Be-Fit programma; wekelijks sporten met collega’s.

  • Ook gewoon een superleuke tijd!

Over Benchmark

Benchmark in Almelo maakt onderdeel uit van de multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., een beursgenoteerde onderneming op het gebied van het vervaardigen van elektronica en het leveren van diensten richting original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s).

Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met productie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd.

Wereldwijd heeft Benchmark Electronics Inc. momenteel 23 vestigingen. Op onze vestiging in Almelo werken we samen met zo’n 675 collega’s.

Interesse?

Benchmark wil vooruit, samen met jou als HR-Stagiair(e)!

Het verstrekken van een VOG is een vast onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure bij Benchmark.

data.title: Junior Data Consultant
data.description:
Onze Missie

LOGEX is koploper in data-analyse in de gezondheidzorg. Wij zetten complexe zorgdata om in heldere inzichten waarmee zorgorganisaties grip krijgen op kosten, betere behandelresultaten realiseren en sturen op waardegedreven zorg. Onze oplossingen worden dagelijks gebruikt door meer dan 80 zorginstellingen, zowel publiek als privaat, en maken het verschil in de gezondheidszorg van morgen.

Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je verhoogt de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening door het valideren van financiële en zorginhoudelijke data. 

  • Je communiceert met klanten over hun data-aanlevering en de oplevering van LOGEX modellen. 

  • Je ontwikkelt je in de breedte en biedt ondersteuning aan meerdere teams en klanten als er vragen liggen met betrekking tot de kwaliteit van data. 

  • Je signaleert en realiseert kansen om interne operationele processen te verbeteren. 

  • Je draagt bij aan automatisering van onze operationele processen, mogelijk door inzet van AI.   

Team

Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. 


Jouw profiel

  • Communicatie: Je kunt effectief communiceren met diverse teamleden en interne stakeholders. 

  • Je bent resultaatgericht, werkt gestructureerd en hebt een pragmatische instelling. 

  • Bereidheid om te leren en aan te passen aan innovatieve technologieën, tools en processen. 

  • Een proactieve benadering om nieuwe taken op te pakken en kansen te zoeken om bij te dragen. 

  • Je krijgt energie van het verbeteren van  werkprocessen. 

  • Taalvaardigheden: Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. 

Wat wij bieden:

Bij LOGEX hebben we één superkracht: data-analyse. Wij kiezen ervoor deze superkracht in te zetten om de huidige problemen in de gezondheidszorg aan te pakken door gegevens te vertalen naar betere zorg.

Klaar om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van de zorg?

data.title: Android Engineer
data.description:
Who are we?

We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.

About the role

Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface.

Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps.

This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team.


What You'll Build & Own

  • On-device Android software: Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end.

  • Fleet-ready releases: Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe.

  • Hardware & firmware integration: Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions.

  • Mobile contribution: Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it.

  • AI-native development: Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship.

What You Bring

  • Solid Android engineering experience: A minimum of 3-5 years building and shipping Android apps in Kotlin, with a solid grasp of the platform (lifecycle, concurrency). You should be able to judge which Android patterns fit a non-standard system, and to design features that contribute to a scalable, reliable system.

  • Curiosity for Android beyond the traditional mobile world: kiosk, embedded, or AOSP work is a strong plus. Pragmatic problem solver who’s comfortable working outside of familiar mobile patterns.

  • Work independently on well-scoped tasks. When scope is unclear, flag it, reach out to the right people, and get the answers and support you need to unblock yourself. Plan the work, communicate progress early, and deliver end to end.

  • AI-native coding is how you work. You build with AI agents daily, you have a sharp setup, and your output shows it. If your last six months of work doesn't look meaningfully different because of AI, this isn't your role.

Everfield is located throughout Europe, with offices in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Poland, Spain, and Latvia.

The Position

As a Senior Data Engineer at Everfield, you will leverage your expertise and experience to:

  • Continuously improve scalability and stability of our data platform called the Lakehouse

  • Create new data pipeline solutions on various data sources (ERP, CRMs, etc.)

You’ll be working as part of the Business Intelligence (BI) team. Currently the team consists of a Lead Data Engineer, three Data Analysts and a hands-on team lead. The team builds pipelines with Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics to ingest the data into our data platform, uses Azure Databricks for data transformation, Power BI for data visualization and Azure Container Apps to expose data via a MCP server to Claude. For most solutions, the team uses Python and SQL.

For many use cases we work in an agentic way, using Claude to plan and implement them. To support this, we built the "Lakehouse DevKit". A set of agents and skills that we plan to keep extending and improving.

This role is hybrid from Amsterdam area.

Responsibilities

data.title: Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark

Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still being the person who gets hands-on and builds those solutions?

As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself.

You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security.

This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office)
Start Date: January/February 2027

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead complex AI discovery
    Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype.

  • Build AI solutions yourself
    Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. You won’t only define what should be built or hand it over to others. You’ll be actively involved in building it.

  • Shape enterprise AI initiatives
    Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful.

  • Design for production
    Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value.

  • Create reusable AI patterns
    Develop approaches for grounding, identity, integration, monitoring and evaluation that can be reused across teams, and identify opportunities for shared AI capabilities.

  • Coach and challenge others
    Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group, while remaining an active builder yourself.

  • Strengthen responsible AI
    Contribute to our AI framework and guardrails, promote responsible use of AI and help create visibility around our AI initiatives.

Who you are

You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You know the difference between an impressive AI demo and a solution that creates measurable business value. You enjoy working independently, bringing different perspectives together and sharing what you learn along the way.

Most importantly, you’re a builder. You enjoy getting hands-on with technology, experimenting, developing prototypes and turning ideas into working solutions. You may have led technical initiatives, defined architecture or coached others, but you haven’t moved away from building things yourself, and you don’t want to.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • A proven track record of delivering complex AI, automation, integration, data or cloud solutions

  • Strong solution design skills across applications, APIs, identity, data, integrations and cloud services

  • Experience taking ambiguous business problems from discovery through prototyping, testing and solution design

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, connectors and/or MCP

  • Development or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# or PowerShell

Our technology

Our AI and technology landscape includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Teams, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI services, Microsoft Foundry, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, MCP, Entra ID and Git.

Let us introduce Sunweb Group  

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.

data.title: Software Engineer (Python & Cloud)
data.description:
Build the software behind large-scale battery storage

Solar and wind power are not always available when we need electricity. Large-scale battery storage helps by storing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises. This keeps the grid flexible and reduces reliance on fossil fuels.

But how do you connect a battery site of hundreds of megawatts to a central IT platform? And how do you build software that is ready for the projects still to come? As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on.

About GIGA Storage

Founded in 2018, we are an international scale-up growing across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Our purpose, ‘Unlock every Green Watt’, is about making the energy system better and more affordable for future generations. We aim to have 1.5 to 2 GW of battery power operational by 2030. At 2 GW, that is theoretically enough peak power to supply more than a million homes simultaneously.

We pioneer at a scale where many solutions are still being developed. We take ownership, share knowledge and make decisions together. Rapid growth also calls for adaptability: priorities shift and not everything is defined in advance.

Your role

You develop and grow our Giga platform. You build software in Python, working with technologies including SQL, Terraform, Grafana and data processing. You do not need to know everything already: you enjoy learning beyond your own specialism.

What will you work on? When a new battery site goes live, data on capacity, performance and equipment status needs to flow reliably into our platform. You build the software and integrations that make this happen. At the same time, you strengthen the foundations: fewer manual steps, better-documented code and reusable solutions for future sites. We work by the principle ‘you build it, you run it’. You can propose tools and improvements; important technical decisions are made together with the team and our IT Lead.

What will you do?

  • Build software. Develop and maintain Python services and integrations for new battery sites.

  • Make data reliable. Build and improve data pipelines, quality checks and monitoring.

  • Work smarter. Automate repeatable tasks and improve documentation, standards and maintainability, using AI tools where useful.

  • Own what you build. Test, deploy and support your software, and discuss technical improvements with the team.

  • Add knowledge, creativity and fun to the IT team.

What do you bring?

  • Higher professional education (HBO) level of thinking and working, and at least four years of relevant software development experience.

  • Python experience; one year may be sufficient if you have also programmed in other languages.

  • Experience with at least one cloud platform: GCP, AWS or Azure.

  • Interest in data engineering and DevOps; Terraform, SQL and CI/CD knowledge is a plus.

  • A broad technical mindset, ownership and a willingness to automate, document and share knowledge.

  • Good English communication skills and availability to work from our Amsterdam office at least three days a week.

Energy-sector experience and Dutch language skills are not required.

Why join GIGA Storage?

  • Visible impact. Your software helps bring new battery sites into operation.

  • Technical variety. Combine software, data and cloud while broadening your skills.

  • Room to contribute. Help automate our platform and prepare it for the next stage of growth.

  • Build together. Join five international IT colleagues in our new Buitenveldert office, close to Amsterdam Zuid.

What do we offer?

  • A competitive salary plus holiday allowance (8%)

  • A fixed year-end bonus (7-9%) and performance-related bonus (max 10%).

  • 28 days of annual leave for full-time employment

  • A pension plan.

  • A €750 annual learning budget, laptop, phone allowance and e-bike scheme.

  • Hybrid working: at least three days a week in our Amsterdam office; choose home or office for the remaining days.

  • Healthy lunches and occasional fun activities

Ready to build with us?

Want to develop software that matters while working on the energy transition? Apply through our website. We look forward to meeting you!

  • Drive for high engineering standards by implementing good software development practices and challenging the team to come up with good designs

  • Maintain a high-performance culture through fostering accountability, being on top of performance management and focusing on employee engagement

  • Oversee and improve the hiring process for platform engineers

  • You work based on data when you can, and you ensure future decisions take data into account

💡 What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager leading team leads (preferred) or senior engineers

  • Ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team while managing performance and professional development

  • You have a history of being a software engineer and know how to build high-quality software and the trade-offs that are to be made

  • You are experienced with functional programming concepts, and are comfortable working with either Haskell, Scala, or Rust. Experience with Python is a plus.

  • Outstanding communication skills - you're just as comfortable talking to engineers as you are with stakeholders

  • You are collaborative, empowering, and adaptable - ready to take on challenges and contribute to strategic decision-making

  • A mindset focused on pragmatism and growth - you care about setting a high standard for yourself and your team and you continue to reflect to become more productive with minimal technical debt

Some practical things we expect from you:

  • You’re available for at least 32 hours per week

  • You're willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week

  • You have a valid work permit, and you're located in the Netherlands

Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, Redis, Ansible, Terraform, React, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.


Important note: We understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

Note: The official job title for this role within Channable is Engineering Manager.

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, and more than +40 nationalities.
Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

🌟 Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.


What do we offer?

  • Gross annual salary ranging from € 100k-120k, including the 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. 

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: You can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 


How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Important note: In the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the screening process, so we can get to know the real person behind the resume.

Note: Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration, and we believe in a diverse and inclusive team

data.title: Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy
data.description:
0.8 – 1 fte week | Utrecht | Hybride | Hbo/wo

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Berenschot is op zoek naar een Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy. Ben jij een expert op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging en privacy en combineer je inhoudelijke kennis met een pragmatische aanpak? En wil je samen met collega’s bouwen aan een verantwoorde balans tussen informatiebeveiliging, privacy en het benutten van kansen die de snelle ontwikkeling in automatisering en AI bieden? Dan zoeken wij jou.

Dit ga je doen

Als Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy zorg je ervoor dat informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen Berenschot niet alleen goed zijn geregeld op papier, maar vooral ook in de praktijk. Je vertaalt beleid, risico’s en wet- en regelgeving naar concrete maatregelen en helpt collega’s om deze toe te passen.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Information Security & Privacy Officer (ISO/PO), de Functionaris Gegevensbescherming (FG), IT en verschillende teams binnen Berenschot. Vanuit jouw rol houd je overzicht, coördineer je verbeteracties en steek je zelf de handen uit de mouwen. Je bent dus niet alleen adviserend bezig, maar zorgt er ook voor dat zaken daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd. Je bevordert het bewustzijn en de kennis van informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen de organisatie en ondersteunt bij incidenten, risicoanalyses en assessments.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van het informatiebeveiligings- en privacybeleid en de vertaling hiervan naar praktische afspraken en acties.

  • Periodiek rapporteren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy aan de directie en het management, met concrete aandachtspunten en voorstellen voor verbetering.

  • Het signaleren en beoordelen van risico’s en het uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en DPIA’s samen met collega’s.

  • Het onderhouden en verder verbeteren van het Information Security Management System (ISMS) en daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van onder andere de AVG, NIS2 en ISO 27001.

  • Het coördineren van verbeteracties en ondersteunen bij informatiebeveiligingsincidenten en datalekken.

  • Het vergroten van bewustzijn binnen de organisatie en collega’s praktisch adviseren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy.

  • De rol biedt nadrukkelijk ruimte om te groeien. Naarmate je de organisatie en het vakgebied beter leert kennen, pak je steeds meer regie en ontwikkel je je verder van een praktisch en coördinerende rol naar een meer tactische en strategische adviesrol.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je korte lijnen hebt met collega’s en de ruimte krijgt om verbeteringen voor te stellen en op te pakken.


Dit neem je mee

Je hebt een stevige basis in informatiebeveiliging en privacy en vindt het leuk om zaken daadwerkelijk voor elkaar te krijgen. Je kunt beleid en risico’s vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en voelt je prettig in een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Tegelijkertijd heb je de ambitie om je verder te ontwikkelen en op termijn ook meer strategische verantwoordelijkheid te pakken.

Daarbij neem je mee:

  • Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau; bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van securitymanagement, bestuurskunde of bedrijfskunde.

  • Minimaal vijf jaar werkervaring en relevante ervaring op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging en/of privacy.

  • Kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving en normenkaders, zoals de AVG, BIO, ABRO, NIS2, NEN7510 en ISO 27001.

  • Het vermogen om risico’s en beleid te vertalen naar concrete, werkbare maatregelen en acties.

  • Een praktische en zelfstandige houding: je adviseert, organiseert én pakt zelf zaken op.

  • Sterk analytisch vermogen, goede communicatieve vaardigheden en organisatiesensitiviteit, waardoor je collega’s kunt meenemen en verschillende belangen bij elkaar kunt brengen.

Certificeringen als CISSP, CISM, CISA, CISM, CIPP/E, CIPM en CDPO zijn een pré, maar geen vereiste. Belangrijker vinden we dat je de inhoudelijke basis en motivatie hebt om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke commerciële omgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners. Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om te ondernemen en de mogelijkheid om ons in te zetten voor belangrijke maatschappelijke thema’s. Kenmerkend is onze informele cultuur. Berenschot is een platte organisatie met korte communicatielijnen waar echt naar je geluisterd wordt. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei, waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. Ons diverse en inclusieve personeelsbeleid omarmt diversiteit en biedt iedereen gelijke kansen.

In deze functie krijg je ruimte om samen met collega’s de het information- & securitybeleid verder vorm te geven en je inhoudelijk te ontwikkelen. Zo bouw je mee aan de informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen Berenschot én aan je eigen volgende stap.

Natuurlijk hebben we daarnaast ook uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en geweldige ontwikkelmogelijkheden:

  • een jaarcontract, met de absolute intentie om je na één jaar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd aan te bieden

  • een aantrekkelijk marktconform salaris afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring

  • Vakantiegeld; 8% over het brutosalaris.

  • een reguliere collectieve winstdelingsregeling (afhankelijk van het resultaat van de onderneming)

  • een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling

  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bij een fulltime dienstverband maximaal 20 vakantiedagen bij te kopen

  • flexibele feestdagen. We bieden de mogelijkheid om officiële feestdagen te verschuiven naar dagen die voor jou van betekenis zijn.

  • een laptop en telefoon

  • een NS businesscard of kilometervergoeding van € 0.25 cent per km

  • thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,35 per dag

  • de vrijheid om, in afstemming met je collega’s, te bepalen waar en wanneer je werkt

  • volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling via interne én externe opleidingen

Solliciteer meteen

Wil jij een trotse Berenschotter worden en samen met collega’s de informatiebeveiliging en privacy bij Berenschot verder brengen? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Vicky Schats via WhatsApp, e-mail () of telefoon (06-25722612), of met Katinka van Dongen ( of 06-51 30 07 01).

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Heb je gesolliciteerd? Dan ontvang je binnen één werkweek een reactie. Is die positief? Dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een kennismaking. Zijn we na dit gesprek allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een gesprek met collega’s en je toekomstige manager. Dat is het moment om jouw laatste vragen te stellen. Gaan die gesprekken goed? Dan vragen we je om ons assessment te doen. Blijkt daaruit dat jij een echte Berenschotter bent? Dan gaan we snel over tot een concreet aanbod. Hierna ben je een echte Berenschotter en heten we je graag welkom in ons team.

data.description:
Omschrijving

Wij zijn op zoek naar een Senior Adviseur Financiële Bedrijfsvoering voor O&P Rijk, de hr-dienstverlener voor de Rijksoverheid. O&P Rijk is in 2023 ontstaan uit de samenvoeging van UBR Personeel, P-Direkt en Binnenwerk en biedt dienstverlening op het gebied van organisatie en personeel.

In 2026 heeft O&P Rijk de financiële functie laten doorlichten. Deze doorlichting geeft richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling van financiële processen, rapportages, interne beheersing en de inrichting van de organisatie. Als Senior Adviseur Financiële Bedrijfsvoering lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan deze doorontwikkeling en werk je binnen verschillende financiële werkstromen.

Je verzamelt, structureert en analyseert financiële en bedrijfskundige informatie en vertaalt deze naar verbetervoorstellen, rapportages en beslisdocumenten. Daarbij breng je samenhang, voortgang, afhankelijkheden, risico’s en knelpunten tussen de verschillende werkstromen in beeld.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je werkt financiële vraagstukken uit op het gebied van processen, rollen en verantwoordelijkheden, rapportages, interne beheersing, risicomanagement en het kostprijsmodel.

  • Je verzamelt, ordent en analyseert financiële en bedrijfskundige informatie.

  • Je brengt informatie uit verschillende werkstromen samen tot een integraal beeld en maakt onderlinge afhankelijkheden en raakvlakken inzichtelijk.

  • Je analyseert de voortgang en afwijkingen binnen de financiële werkstromen en signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en verbetermogelijkheden.

  • Je stelt analyses, managementrapportages, verbetervoorstellen en beslisdocumenten op.

  • Je bereidt voorstellen voor en onderbouwt deze voor besluitvorming door de projectmanager en CFO.

  • Je draagt bij aan een eenduidige informatie- en rapportagestructuur en stemt af met de projectmanager en verantwoordelijken van de verschillende werkstromen.


Wat vragen wij?

Eisen:

  • Je beschikt over minimaal WO werk- en denkniveau, aantoonbaar door een afgeronde WO-opleiding en/of minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring op WO-niveau.

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar aantoonbare relevante werkervaring binnen het financieel-economisch functiegebied, waaronder ervaring met projecten en/of verandertrajecten op het gebied van financiële bedrijfsvoering.

  • Je hebt aantoonbare kennis van en ervaring met financiële processen, rapportages, interne beheersing en/of risicomanagement.

Aanvullende wensen:

  • Je hebt kennis van het begrotingsstelsel, regelgeving, voorschriften en procedures op het gebied van overheidsfinanciën.

  • Je bent in staat financiële en bedrijfskundige vraagstukken op strategisch niveau te analyseren en te vertalen naar concrete voorstellen.

  • Je bent in staat informatie uit verschillende werkstromen samen te brengen tot een helder totaalbeeld.

  • Je werkt analytisch, accuraat en gestructureerd en kan schakelen tussen verschillende financiële vraagstukken.

  • Je bent proactief en beschikt over goede advies- en communicatieve vaardigheden.

Informatie

Aantal uur: 28 tot 36 uur per week

Lengte opdracht: 6 maanden met optie tot verlenging

Locatie: Den Haag

Vorm: Detachering (niet geschikt voor zzp)

Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor maandag 30 november 9.00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht.

data.title: Data Analyst - Logistics
data.description:
Maybe you call yourself a Data Specialist, a BI Consultant, a "why-does-this-number-not-match-their-Excel" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam.

Whatever you call yourself: we're bringing a whole group of container terminals onto one data platform, and you will help us do that in the best way by getting to know how the container terminals work and how their data is shaped. Over time, you'll become the person everyone turns to when they need to understand a terminal and its data.

What you get 

  • A salary between €68,000-75,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience. 

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it. 

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months. 

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings. 

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop. 

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", now and then. 

  • Hybrid preferred, with 1-2 days per week in our Rotterdam office. We will consider remote candidates too. We use salary zones, so the range may be lower elsewhere in Europe. If you are applying from outside of the Netherlands, the salary range will be shared before your first interview.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR. 

About us 

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. 

 
What the job looks like 

  • Get under the skin of each container terminal. Walk through its systems and processes with the people who run its day-to-day operations, from maintenance and container vessel operations to the edge-case manual adjustments everyone secretly relies on. Understand how things really work and how operational activities are recorded in their systems.

  • Turn local chaos into a standard set of requirements and data definitions. Help the teams at each terminal understand how their local data contributes to global insights, and translate what you agree with them into concrete requirements for the data engineering team.

  • Own whether the numbers are right. Reconcile our figures with the terminal's own reports, validate them together with the relevant teams, and get problems fixed at their source.

  • Work closely with data engineers and terminal teams towards the same goal. Challenge logic early, explain what a number means (and what it doesn't), and make sure the data reflects reality. The data engineers own the build; you own making sure the result reflects what actually happens at the terminal.

  • Build relationships across the globe. Every week, you'll speak with people from several container terminals across different continents, each with their own processes, systems and history.


What you bring 

  • Attitude and execution: You bring energy and curiosity, along with the discipline to follow things through and close every loop. You know when to speak directly with the terminal operators to solve a challenge, take ownership of finding answers, and understand what the numbers mean for the business without having to be told.

  • Experience: At least 4 years of experience working in a data analyst role, with a track record of taking on increasingly complex challenges. Candidates with more experience are welcome too.

  • Business context: You've worked in an operations or logistics team (or another asset-heavy environment), so you understand how operational businesses work, what questions to ask and why assumptions shouldn't be taken as facts. Experience in a container terminal environment is a big plus, but the rest you learn on the job.

  • Data model literacy: You're not a data engineer, but you're technically confident enough to read and understand a data model, distinguish a modelling problem from a source-data problem, and understand how different data sources connect to test a hypothesis and how metrics behave over time.

  • Reconciliation: You have strong SQL skills and at least basic Python knowledge. You've helped teams bring complex information from different sources together, investigate discrepancies and explain what the numbers mean in plain language. You've used Power BI or a similar tool mainly to explore, check and validate data, rather than to build polished dashboards.

  • AI with a quality radar: You know how to make AI work for you and others, and can judge when it makes sense to use it and when it doesn't. Expect to be asked how you think new tools could impact the way we work, because for us, they already do.

  • Delivery: You're experienced in delivering work within agreed timelines, proactively resolving challenges and taking the initiative to find answers. Experience with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira or Linear is a plus.

  • Language: You communicate clearly and confidently in English, including with operational teams where English is often a second language. Other languages are a plus.

  • Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.

 
We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.
